description:
1. Who I Am: Passionate about building a new Martian civilization using hardware, software, coding, and VR skills.  
2. My Mars Plan: Mining, harnessing solar energy via a Dyson sphere, regulating atmosphere (greenhouse gases/thermonuclear), securing water (ice caps/asteroids), and building soil/ecosystems.  
3. Looking For: Teammates skilled in AI/ML, Space Weather, Mars Satellites, and Art/Multimedia to join this mission!
summary: Creating a new Martian civilization: An Interplanetary Survival Guide & Map using Dyson sphere energy, terraforming, water, and bio-ecosystems.
details: Event Horizon" is an end-to-end Interplanetary Survival Guide and Martian Civilization Blueprint designed to transform Mars into a self-sustaining human habitat. How It Works & Core Pillars: 1. Dyson Sphere Energy: Utilizes an orbital solar collector swarm to beam terawatt-scale clean energy wirelessly to the Martian surface, neutralizing dust storm limitations. 2. Mining & Resource Mapping: Employs orbital radar and autonomous rovers to map high-grade iron, titanium, and subsurface lava tubes for radiation-shielded 3D habitats. 3. Atmosphere & Water: Restores atmospheric pressure via greenhouse gas synthesis and melts polar ice caps/aquifers to secure liquid water. 4. Soil Detoxification & Bio-Ecosystems: Neutralizes toxic perchlorates using engineered microbes and runs closed-loop aeroponic biodomes for 98% water recycling and continuous food production. Impact & Creativity: Provides a scalable, scientifically grounded blueprint for multi-planetary human survival, integrating advanced mega-engineering with local Martian resource utilization.
